title.zh: 将东内格罗斯省Bayawan市-Mabinay省道改设为国道的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Bayawan City - Mabinay Provincial Road in the Province of Negros Oriental Into a National Road
title.orig: An Act Converting the Bayawan City - Mabinay Provincial Road in the Province of Negros Oriental Into a National Road
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Đường Bayawan City - Mabinay Provincial tại Tỉnh Negros Oriental thành Đường Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะถนน Bayawan City - Mabinay Provincial ในจังหวัด Negros Oriental เป็นถนนแห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Jalan Bayawan City - Mabinay Provincial di Provinsi Negros Oriental menjadi Jalan Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Jalan Bayawan City - Mabinay Provincial di Wilayah Negros Oriental kepada Jalan Kebangsaan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2010/ra_10077_2010.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Bayawan City - Mabinay Provincial Road in the Province of Negros Oriental is hereby converted into a national road.
The Secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
